question: The following patients are sent to the hypertension clinic. Indicate which one you would NOT suspect secondary hypertension.

options.opa: 25 year old woman with an abdominal puff.
options.opb: Hypertension with hypokalemia in a 50-year-old man who does not take drugs.
options.opc: A 55-year-old woman with a body mass index of 28 and dyslipidemia.
options.opd: A 78-year-old woman who has not been controlled with 3 drugs for 3 months.
options.ope: Man of 60 years with daytime sleepiness, morning headache and snoring.
